name: Future Retail Limited
remarksWeb: In the above paid up capital, 1,542 Optionally Convertible Debentures (OCDs) of Rs. 10 lakh each, issued pursuant to the Composite Scheme of Arrangement between Future Enterprises Limited (earlier known as Future Retail Limited) with the Company, becoming effective on May 1, 2016, have not been considered as the conversion price of these securities would be determinable at any time during the tenure of the OCDs or latest by October 31, 2017, when the option for conversion is exercised. Further, as per terms of isssue, these securities may be redeemed in case conversion option is not exercised.    Future Corporate Resources Limited ("FCRL") part of Promoter / Promoter Group acuired 36,25,000 Shares (17,50,000 Shares on 29th March, 2017 & 18,75,000 Shares on 30th March, 2017) from open market, was not reflecting in the beneficiary position received from the R & T Agent, have been reduced from the category "Clearing Members" and added under the category of "Promoter / Promoter Group". This is based on the disclosures submitted by Promoter / Promoter Group under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 and SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.    16,84,663 Equity Shares (Lock-in shares) held by Ryka Commercial Ventures Private Limited ("Ryka") were transferred to Gargi Business Ventures Private Limited ("Gargi") on 30th March, 2017 by way of Inter-se Transfer under regulation 10(1)(a)(iii) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. Further, entire holding of Future Capital Investment Private Limited (FCIPL) was also transferred to Gargi on 30th March, 2017 by way of Inter-se Transfer. This is based on the disclosure submitted by Promoter / Promoter Group under SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 and SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.  Post inter-se transfer of shares by Ryka and FCIPL to Gargi, their holding is Nil, however, they continue to remain part of Promoter / Promoter Group.    Retail Trust, having indirect shareholding in the Company, being Promoter of the Company, but not holding any equity shares, have been included. Retail Trust holds shares in FCRL.    Bennett, Coleman & Company Limited ("BCCL") aquired 23,00,000 and 18,00,000 Shares of the Company on 31st March, 2017 from its PAC's i.e. Vardhaman Publishers Limited & Dharmayug Investments Limited respectively and accordingly, shareholding of BCCL was increased from 4.32% to 5.19%. This was not reflecting in the beneficiary position received from the R & T Agent and same have been reduced from the category of "Clearing members" and added under above folio under shareholding pattern. However, post acquisition the agreegate shareholding of BCCL along with PAC's remained same (i.e. 11.03%) in the Company.  This is based on the discosure dated 04th April, 2017 submitted by BCCL under Regulation 29(1) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
